from modules.worker_ingress import service
from modules.worker_ingress.semantic_capabilities import registered_capabilities

REQ={"objective":"Gate3B","bounded_context":"RRHH_CUSTODIA","mode":"READ_ONLY","capability":"RRHH_CUSTODIA_GATE3B_SQL_PREFLIGHT","constraints":{}}

def test_rrhh_custodia_gate3b_capability():
    assert "RRHH_CUSTODIA_GATE3B_SQL_PREFLIGHT" in registered_capabilities()
    job=service.build_semantic_job(REQ,current_user={"email":"admin@example.com"})
    assert job["mode"]=="READ_ONLY"
    assert job["production_allowed"] is False
    assert job["actions"]==[]
    assert len(job["checks"])==1
    assert job["checks"][0]["type"]=="sql_readonly_audit"
    assert len(job["checks"][0]["queries"])==7

objective: Registrar en Desarrollo la capability fija RRHH_CUSTODIA_GATE3B_SQL_PREFLIGHT para ejecutar únicamente un preflight SQL READ_ONLY de Custodia. Debe aceptar solo constraints vacíos, emitir actions=[], un único sql_readonly_audit con 7 consultas fijas y no tocar Producción.
